# Learn the actual channel: effective rank and recoverability are separate

30 October 2026. **PROPOSED; complete independent whole challenge pending.**
Root personally develops the central approximate-competitor principle. B owns
copy-acquired common spectral filtering and threshold resources. C owns the
N1291 transfer and finite uniform small-irrep preparation. A independently
challenges the complete operation. No source, device or numerical fixture has
been run for this construction.

## 1. A stronger question than closeness to an exact encoder

Let N:C^k -> C^D be one fixed memoryless CPTP source. Its actual mean output is
A=N(I_k/k). Suppose there EXISTS a mathematical recovery R0 with

    F_e(R0 N,I_k/k)>=1-kappa.                           (1.1)

No R0 gate, adjoint, Stinespring oracle or description is supplied. Let

    tail_d0(A)=sum_(j>d0) lambda_j(A)<=tau.              (1.2)

The index d0 is a supplied intrinsic-size upper bound; tau and kappa can be
analysis parameters rather than values known to the algorithm. Conditions(1.1)
and(1.2) are independent. We do NOT assume N is diamond-close to a particular
perfect mixed-isometry source. This removes the previous exact-model supplier
instead of comparing every training carrier with that unknown ideal channel.

Physical access is paid: forward source calls accept entangled Choi inputs;
fresh copies of A are made by N(I_k/k); all Choi training outputs and references
can stay coherent until the late payload arrives. Known carrier controls and
joint reference-safe compression are available with their actual gate/storage
costs. This is a one-batch quantum operation, not a reusable classical decoder
learned before an unlimited late stream or an uncontrolled memoryful source.

## 2. One actual spectral cutoff

Choose a rational threshold c in[a,2a], and let Pi=1_[c,infinity)(A). Define

    F(rho)=Pi N(rho)Pi
             direct_sum Tr[(I-Pi)N(rho)] |fail><fail|.

The flag is orthogonal to retained carrier space. Its mean rank is at most
floor(1/a)+1. With t=Tr[(I-Pi)A], the top-d0 eigenvalues below cutoff contribute
at most2d0 a and the remainder contributes at most tau, so

    t<=tau+2d0 a.                                     (2.1)

This elementary tail bound uses the actual A; it is not a tomography estimate
or an assumption that all source outputs are uniformly near one subspace.

## 1. Question, inputs and output

Let N be one fixed memoryless CPTP map from known k-dimensional logical
inputs to a known D-dimensional output carrier. Only FORWARD calls are
available, including entangled inputs, and trusted known controls on the
carriers. The controller receives no N-adjoint, isometry, environment,
purification, state matrix, spectrum, eigenbasis or exact-support oracle.
It can acquire independent copies of `A=N(I_k/k)` by actual forward calls.

Given rational `0<a<=1/8`, `0<beta_gap<=1/2`, `0<zeta<=1/2`, the port
chooses ONE finite random rational threshold t and implements an
always-defined CPTP filter approximating

`F_t(rho)=Pi_t N(rho) Pi_t
          direct_sum Tr[(I-Pi_t)N(rho)] |fail><fail|`,
`Pi_t=1_[t,infinity)(A)`.                              (1)

The failure flag is a known orthogonal state. A physical carrier is a
flag qubit plus the D-level output; on failure reset the data register.
The pass branch is NOT dephased in A's eigenbasis.

For every selected t, even bad ones, the ideal F_t has a COMMON support
of rank at most `1/a+1`, independent of the input state, its reference,
and the number of later calls. With probability at least1-beta_gap/4,
the returned finite circuit has FULL diamond distance at most zeta from
F_t on arbitrary source/reference inputs. The circuit and output branch
are physically defined on bad thresholds too; no per-record claim that
the threshold is spectrally good is made.

The same threshold is reused throughout one training/payload batch.
It is not redrawn independently for separate source outputs. The rank
bound is a mathematical property of one actual channel F_t; it is not
an exact-rank assumption on N's noisy outputs.

# Learning an approximately recoverable channel in one shared compressed frame

30 October 2026. C proof, paired with B's spectral-filter
acquisition. This is an ideal quantum algorithm, not hardware access.
The N1291 accepted compression/recovery inputs remain frozen. This file
extends their actual competitor argument; it does not reopen acceptance.

## 1. Metrics, inputs and the actual output task

Write d_half(A,B)=||A-B||_diamond/2. Entanglement fidelity Fe is the
Bell-target probability for the NORMALIZED k-dimensional Choi state.
The source is one unknown, fixed, memoryless CPTP channel N:k -> D.
Forward calls permit entangled logical inputs. Outputs, references and a
later payload can be held coherently and processed jointly. No unknown
Stinespring circuit, channel adjoint, environment, original-frame decoder
or source model is provided.

For one fixed projector P on the output define the trace-preserving flagged
filter J_P(X)=PXP + Tr[(I-P)X]|fail><fail|. The failure flag is orthogonal
to the success space. Let F=J_P N, and let d bound its common output-support
dimension. Filter implementation errors are charged separately against
this ONE ideal F; physical noise in N is never replaced by a perfect
source on every program carrier.

The target is a physical one-batch decoded logical channel, uniformly on
all payload states and adjoining references. The learned small decoder
belongs to this batch; no reusable original-D or streaming decoder follows.

## 2. Agnostic approximate-competitor theorem

Suppose some mathematical CPTP R0 has Fe(R0 F)>=1-zeta. It need not be
known, implemented, unique or a perfect recovery. Let the N1291 finite
tomography/affine-repair/ridge procedure estimate the actual small F with
d_half(Fhat,F)<=delta on its good event. Here 0<=delta<=1. The corrected
all-accepted inverse floor, physical depolarizing fallback and finite
rational feasibility decision from the completed review are mandatory.

For the learned Petz recovery Rhat at I_k/k, Barnum--Knill Theorem3/Eq13
applied to the singleton ensemble gives

 Fe(Rhat Fhat) >= max(0,1-zeta-delta)^2.

Indeed the same R0 has fidelity at least 1-zeta-delta on Fhat. Transferring
